scope: Development diagnostics on the same optically coded non-anatomical simulated sheet. Not M5 acceptance.
local_chart: Use the v1.5 RGB-D evidence and quality thresholds. Both external endpoints must still be independently observed on both banks in the same frame. Retain internal boundaries observed on both banks; a well-observed but contradictory boundary still invalidates the whole chart. A front is convertible only at a directly observed row or between two supported consecutive design rows. Report the supporting rows, the local interval and progress. Never interpolate or extrapolate over an unverified row, or use a new chart with a memory-only slit.
control: Keep v1.5's same-frame fresh slit and 0.25 mm minimum post-closure progress increase. Map the target and hard limit normally when their local cell has both adjacent rows. If a target/limit falls inside a gap in the chart, use the last verified row before it. For the sweep, use that row's existing earlier-bank boundary and subtract the unchanged physical sweep reserve. This monotone fallback ends at the verified row, not at an inferred location of the missing row. Recompute after advance before closure. No changes to instruments, 9-10 mm truth acceptance, motion/pose/sharpness thresholds, or recovery/collision budgets.
trials: Compare the marked truth nominal trace at yaw +4.5 deg, pitch 0 and insertion 0.080 m with the prior same-view unmarked trace. Run traced marked vision nominal (seed 0) and 0.5 mm depth noise (seed 1) from the same diagnostic pose. Quantify complete/partial chart and usable-front counts, report each closure, reacquisition, peak and terminal true length and failures. No new holdout evaluation or camera qualification.
